description: Safety-first X (Twitter) API v2 MCP server: 41 typed tools across 12 packages, policy-gated.
name: io.github.IvanBBaev/x-mcp-ai

environmentVariables.description: Path to the rotating OAuth 2.0 token store (default: OS-resolved).
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_TOKEN_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep OAuth 2.0 tokens in the OS keychain (macOS, Linux) instead of a token file. Mutually exclusive with an explicit X_MCP_TOKEN_FILE.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_TOKEN_KEYCHAIN

environmentVariables.description: Policy preset: read-only (default), engage, publish, manage, or full.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_POLICY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated op:domain cells to allow on top of the preset (e.g. read:dm,write:dm).
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_POLICY_ALLOW

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated op:domain cells to deny; deny beats allow beats preset.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_POLICY_DENY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to drop policy-denied tools from registration entirely instead of registering them annotated as denied.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_HIDE_DENIED

environmentVariables.description: Directory uploads must resolve inside. Media upload is disabled unless this is set.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_MEDIA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated specially-provisioned access classes to declare: pilot, premium-user, enterprise. Unset means the conservative default (app+user, user-only).
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_AVAILABILITY

environmentVariables.description: Path to a profiles file holding named configuration blocks.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_PROFILES_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Name of the profile to select from the profiles file.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_PROFILE

environmentVariables.description: Diagnostic verbosity on stderr: silent, error, info (default), or debug.
environmentVariables.name: X_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
